title: Query resource creation
summary: Recover 0x4a4c50 as an i386 thiscall owner member: create two groups of types 10,10,12 through stdcall COM slot +0x1d8, stop on signed HRESULT failure and release/null all six slots in original callback-visible order. Device is reloaded before each create. Callers ignore the unspecified return register. Cleanup dependency 0x4a4d20 is represented only as needed for this routine.
test_description: Differential original_query_create tests cover all six failure positions and success, all 64 initial pointer masks, failure output unchanged/assigned/null, HRESULT 0/1/INT_MAX and -1/INT_MIN/D3D error, callback device replacement and query-slot mutation. Compare full owner, tail canaries and callback logs including slot snapshots; explicitly check types, destination addresses, call counts, cleared failure slots and untouched fields.
known_limits: No byte-matching claim; original incidental EAX values are not an API return contract.
COM device/query implementations are test doubles; real GPU allocation and driver behavior remain external.
Requires original 32-bit pointer layout; invalid owner/device/vtable pointers remain invalid as in original.
Names and higher-level purposes of query fields remain unresolved; no exception or concurrency guarantees added.
